name: frontend-spec-plugin
description: Turns product requirements, UI references, API contracts, and project constraints into an implementation-ready frontend specification.

interface.longDescription: A staged frontend analysis pipeline that captures project constraints, structures product requirements, resolves ambiguities, maps APIs and UI, designs interactions and flows, and assembles an implementation-ready development specification without generating application code.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PRD, UI reference, and API contract into a frontend specification.
Find the missing decisions in this frontend requirement before development starts.
Update this frontend specification while preserving confirmed manual decisions.
